+### SM100 sparse Sage FP8 for MiniMax-H3
+
+Select `--attention-backend transformer=subblock_sparse_attn_fp8` on SM100
+(B200/GB200). This backend requires FlashInfer's blk64 Sage FP8 kernel
+(PR #5241), opt-in strided TRT-LLM Sage quantization, and direct BSHD output
+support. It also uses the plane-major Ulysses option described above.
+
+Routing uses BF16 Q/K and Q64 x K64 blocks (`n_q=4`, `n_k=4`), with the
+existing sparsity and denoising-step schedule. Quantization uses E4M3 for
+Q/K/V: Q scales per token/head, K scales per 16 tokens/head, and V scales
+per head/channel across the sequence. K smoothing is disabled. Sequence
+lengths remain unpadded; the attention kernel handles partial tail blocks.
+
+The single-document path preserves strided Q/K/V views and writes attention
+directly into BSHD output. This avoids input materialization, output reordering,
+and segment assembly kernels when the kernel uses one KV split. Multiple KV
+splits retain FlashInfer's merge path. Multiple documents may require dense
+segment writes or alignment-tail zeroing. Batched and grouped-query inputs
+use dense attention; the sparse FP8 path supports a batch of one with equal
+Q/K/V head counts and head dimension 128.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""SM100 SubBlock Sage FP8 attention for MiniMax-H3.
+
+Uses BF16 Q/K routing, uniform Q64 x K64 top-k, TRT-LLM E4M3 quantization
+(Q per token/head, K per 16 tokens/head, V per head/channel), and no K
+smoothing. The true sequence length is passed through without padding.
+Select with transformer=subblock_sparse_attn_fp8; this is independent of
+architecture-specific compute_mode choices on the general SubBlock backend.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import functools
+
+import flashinfer
+import msgspec
+import torch
+
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.attention.backends.attention_backend import (
+    AttentionBackend,
+    AttentionImpl,
+)
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.attention.backends.subblock_sparse import (
+    SubBlockRouter,
+)
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.attention.backends.subblock_sparse_attn import (
+    SubBlockSparseAttentionMetadata,
+    SubBlockSparseAttentionMetadataBuilder,
+    SubBlockSparseSchedule,
+    _dit_layer_index,
+)
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.managers.forward_context import get_forward_context
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.platforms import AttentionBackendEnum
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.utils.logging_utils import init_logger
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+
+@functools.lru_cache(maxsize=1)
+def load_sage_attention():
+    from flashinfer.cute_dsl.sparse.bsa_attn_sm100_blk64 import (
+        bsa_attn_sm100_blk64_fwd,
+    )
+
+    return bsa_attn_sm100_blk64_fwd
+
+
+SUBBLOCK_SPARSE_HEAD_DIM = 128
+
+
+@functools.lru_cache(maxsize=32)
+def _quant_cu_seqlens(seq_len: int, device: torch.device) -> torch.Tensor:
+    # Reuse immutable metadata instead of uploading two tiny tensors per layer.
+    return torch.tensor([0, seq_len], dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+
+
+def _quantize_sage_fp8(
+    q: torch.Tensor,  # [1, S, H, D] bf16 — S need NOT be a multiple of 64
+    k: torch.Tensor,
+    v: torch.Tensor,
+) -> tuple[
+    torch.Tensor,  # q_fp8   [1, S, H, D]  float8_e4m3fn
+    torch.Tensor,  # k_fp8   [1, S, H, D]  float8_e4m3fn
+    torch.Tensor,  # v_fp8   [1, S, H, D]  float8_e4m3fn
+    torch.Tensor,  # q_scale [1, H, S]     float32
+    torch.Tensor,  # k_scale [1, H, ceil(S/16)]  float32
+    torch.Tensor,  # v_scale [H, D]        float32
+]:
+    """Sage-FP8 quantisation for the blk64 Sage-FP8 kernel, via flashinfer's
+    fused ``trtllm_sage_attention_quantize`` kernel.
+
+    Granularity follows the upstream kernel contract (see
+    ``validate_sm100_blk64_fp8_sage`` in flashinfer):
+      Q: one scale per (token, head).
+      K: one scale per (16-token bucket, head).
+      V: one scale per (head, dim) — global across the sequence.
+
+    Quantizes and returns at the true (possibly non-64-aligned) sequence
+    length -- the attention kernel handles the tail natively, so there is
+    nothing to pad here.
+    """
+    # Plane-major Ulysses views have packed heads/channels and a strided
+    # token dimension. Preserve these views to avoid three input copies.
+    q_fp8, k_fp8, v_fp8, q_scale, k_scale, v_scale = (
+        flashinfer.trtllm_sage_attention_quantize(
+            q.squeeze(0),
+            k.squeeze(0),
+            v.squeeze(0),
+            q_block_size=1,
+            k_block_size=16,
+            qk_quant_dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn,
+            cum_seq_lens_q=_quant_cu_seqlens(q.shape[1], q.device),
+            cum_seq_lens_kv=_quant_cu_seqlens(k.shape[1], k.device),
+            smooth_k=False,
+            allow_strided_input=True,
+        )
+    )
+    # q_fp8/k_fp8/v_fp8: [S, H, D]; q_scale: [H, S]; k_scale: [H, ceil(S/16)]; v_scale: [H, D]
+
+    q_fp8 = q_fp8.unsqueeze(0)  # [1, S, H, D]
+    k_fp8 = k_fp8.unsqueeze(0)
+    v_fp8 = v_fp8.unsqueeze(0)
+    q_scale = q_scale.unsqueeze(0)  # [1, H, S]
+    k_scale = k_scale.unsqueeze(0)  # [1, H, ceil(S/16)]
+
+    return q_fp8, k_fp8, v_fp8, q_scale, k_scale, v_scale
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Backend / metadata classes (thin wrappers reusing the bf16 counterparts)
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+class SubBlockSparseAttentionFP8Backend(AttentionBackend):
+    @staticmethod
+    def get_supported_head_sizes() -> list[int]:
+        return [SUBBLOCK_SPARSE_HEAD_DIM]
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def get_enum() -> AttentionBackendEnum:
+        return AttentionBackendEnum.SUBBLOCK_SPARSE_ATTN_FP8
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def get_impl_cls() -> type[SubBlockSparseAttentionFP8Impl]:
+        return SubBlockSparseAttentionFP8Impl
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def get_metadata_cls() -> type[SubBlockSparseAttentionMetadata]:
+        return SubBlockSparseAttentionMetadata
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def get_builder_cls() -> type[SubBlockSparseAttentionMetadataBuilder]:
+        return SubBlockSparseAttentionMetadataBuilder
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Implementation
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+class SubBlockSparseAttentionFP8Impl(AttentionImpl):
+    """VSA blk64 + Sage-FP8: router in bf16, attention kernel in FP8.
+
+    Shares the ``SubBlockSparseSchedule`` config (sparsity, skip_first_steps,
+    etc.) with the bf16 backend.  Dense fallback behaviour is identical.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        num_heads: int,
+        head_size: int,
+        causal: bool = False,
+        softmax_scale: float | None = None,
+        num_kv_heads: int | None = None,
+        prefix: str = "",
+        **extra_impl_args,
+    ) -> None:
+        self.prefix = prefix
+        self.num_heads = num_heads
+        self.head_size = head_size
+        self.causal = causal
+        self.softmax_scale = (
+            softmax_scale if softmax_scale is not None else head_size**-0.5
+        )
+        self.num_kv_heads = num_kv_heads if num_kv_heads is not None else num_heads
+
+        self.schedule = SubBlockSparseSchedule.from_server_args()
+        from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.server_args import get_global_server_args
+
+        config = get_global_server_args().attention_backend_config or {}
+        self.schedule = msgspec.structs.replace(
+            self.schedule, n_k=int(config.get("n_k", 4)), compute_mode="sage_fp8"
+        )
+        self.layer_idx = _dit_layer_index(prefix)
+
+        self.layer_enabled = (
+            self.layer_idx is not None
+            and self.layer_idx >= self.schedule.skip_first_layers
+            and head_size == SUBBLOCK_SPARSE_HEAD_DIM
+            and self.schedule.sparsity > 0.0
+        )
+
+        self.router = (
+            SubBlockRouter(n_k=self.schedule.n_k, n_q=self.schedule.n_q)
+            if self.layer_enabled
+            else None
+        )
+        self.dense_impl = self._build_dense_impl(causal=causal)
+        if self.layer_enabled:
+            logger.info_once(
+                f"SubBlock FP8 sparse attention [SM100 blk64 Sage-FP8]: "
+                f"sparsity={self.schedule.sparsity:.3f} "
+                f"n_k={self.schedule.n_k} n_q={self.schedule.n_q} "
+                f"num_heads={num_heads}, dense for the first "
+                f"{self.schedule.skip_first_steps} denoise steps and the first "
+                f"{self.schedule.skip_first_layers} DiT layers"
+            )
+
+    def _build_dense_impl(self, *, causal: bool) -> AttentionImpl:
+        from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.attention.selector import (
+            get_attn_backend,
+        )
+
+        backend = get_attn_backend(
+            self.head_size,
+            torch.bfloat16,
+            supported_attention_backends={
+                AttentionBackendEnum.FA,
+                AttentionBackendEnum.TORCH_SDPA,
+            },
+            selected_attention_backend=AttentionBackendEnum.FA,
+        )
+        return backend.get_impl_cls()(
+            num_heads=self.num_heads,
+            head_size=self.head_size,
+            causal=causal,
+            softmax_scale=self.softmax_scale,
+            num_kv_heads=self.num_kv_heads,
+            prefix=f"{self.prefix}.dense",
+        )
+
+    def _step_enabled(self) -> bool:
+        return get_forward_context().current_timestep >= self.schedule.skip_first_steps
+
+    def _sparse_ready(self, q: torch.Tensor, k: torch.Tensor) -> bool:
+        return (
+            self.layer_enabled
+            and self._step_enabled()
+            and q.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+            and (q.ndim == 3 or q.shape[0] == 1)
+            and q.shape[-2] == k.shape[-2]
+            and k.shape[-3] >= self.schedule.min_seq_len
+            and not self.causal
+        )
+
+    def _sparse_attention(
+        self,
+        q: torch.Tensor,
+        k: torch.Tensor,
+        v: torch.Tensor,
+        *,
+        out: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Route BF16 inputs and run Sage FP8 at the true sequence length."""
+        plan = self.router.route(
+            q, k, sparsity=self.schedule.sparsity, softmax_scale=self.softmax_scale
+        )
+        logger.info_once(
+            f"SubBlock FP8 sparse attention active: S={k.shape[1]} heads={q.shape[2]} "
+            f"keeping {plan.topk}/{plan.num_blocks} key blocks per query block "
+            f"(sparsity {1 - plan.density:.4f})"
+        )
+
+        # Step 2: Sage-FP8 quantisation (at true length, no padding).
+        q_fp8, k_fp8, v_fp8, q_scale, k_scale, v_scale = _quantize_sage_fp8(q, k, v)
+
+        # Step 3: FP8 sparse attention.
+        #   - block_sizes=None: the kernel masks a non-64-aligned tail natively.
+        #   - q2k_block_nums=None: uniform topk (guaranteed by SubBlockRouter).
+        #   - kv_splits="auto": uses sm100_blk64_auto_fp8_kv_splits heuristic.
+        kernel = load_sage_attention()
+        if out is None:
+            out = torch.empty(q.shape, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=q.device)
+        out = kernel(
+            q_fp8,
+            k_fp8,
+            v_fp8,
+            plan.index,
+            plan.topk,
+            block_sizes=None,
+            q2k_block_nums=None,
+            softmax_scale=self.softmax_scale,
+            kv_splits="auto",
+            out=out,
+            q_scale=q_scale,
+            k_scale=k_scale,
+            v_scale=v_scale,
+        )
+        return out[0] if isinstance(out, tuple) else out
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        query: torch.Tensor,
+        key: torch.Tensor,
+        value: torch.Tensor,
+        attn_metadata: SubBlockSparseAttentionMetadata | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """query/key/value: ``[B, S, H, D]``."""
+        if not self._sparse_ready(query, key):
+            return self.dense_impl.forward(query, key, value, attn_metadata)
+        return self._sparse_attention(query, key, value)
+
+    def forward_varlen(
+        self,
+        query: torch.Tensor,
+        key: torch.Tensor,
+        value: torch.Tensor,
+        *,
+        cu_seqlens: torch.Tensor,
+        max_seqlen: int,
+        cu_seqlens_host: tuple[int, ...] | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Packed ``[T, H, D]`` rows split into documents by ``cu_seqlens``."""
+
+        def all_dense() -> torch.Tensor:
+            return self.dense_impl.forward_varlen(
+                query,
+                key,
+                value,
+                cu_seqlens=cu_seqlens,
+                max_seqlen=max_seqlen,
+                cu_seqlens_host=cu_seqlens_host,
+            )
+
+        if cu_seqlens_host is None or not self._sparse_ready(query, key):
+            return all_dense()
+
+        segments = [
+            (start, stop)
+            for start, stop in zip(cu_seqlens_host[:-1], cu_seqlens_host[1:])
+            if stop > start
+        ]
+        sparse_segments = {
+            (start, stop)
+            for start, stop in segments
+            if stop - start >= self.schedule.min_seq_len
+        }
+        if not sparse_segments:
+            return all_dense()
+
+        if len(segments) == 1 and segments[0] == (0, query.shape[0]):
+            # Return the single document directly, avoiding output assembly.
+            start, stop = segments[0]
+            q_seg = query.unsqueeze(0)
+            k_seg = key.unsqueeze(0)
+            v_seg = value.unsqueeze(0)
+            seg_out = (
+                self._sparse_attention(q_seg, k_seg, v_seg)
+                if (start, stop) in sparse_segments
+                else self._dense_segment(q_seg, k_seg, v_seg)
+            )
+            return seg_out[0]
+
+        out = torch.empty(query.shape, dtype=query.dtype, device=query.device)
+        if segments[-1][1] < query.shape[0]:
+            out[segments[-1][1] :].zero_()
+        for start, stop in segments:
+            q_seg = query[start:stop].unsqueeze(0)
+            k_seg = key[start:stop].unsqueeze(0)
+            v_seg = value[start:stop].unsqueeze(0)
+            if (start, stop) in sparse_segments:
+                self._sparse_attention(
+                    q_seg, k_seg, v_seg, out=out[start:stop].unsqueeze(0)
+                )
+            else:
+                seg_out = self._dense_segment(q_seg, k_seg, v_seg)
+                out[start:stop] = seg_out[0]
+        return out
+
+    def _dense_segment(
+        self, q: torch.Tensor, k: torch.Tensor, v: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Dense attention over one packed document, ``[1, S, H, D]``."""
+        return torch.nn.functional.scaled_dot_product_attention(
+            q.transpose(1, 2),
+            k.transpose(1, 2),
+            v.transpose(1, 2),
+            is_causal=self.causal,
+            scale=self.softmax_scale,
+        ).transpose(1, 2)
+
+
+__all__ = [
+    "SubBlockSparseAttentionFP8Backend",
+    "SubBlockSparseAttentionFP8Impl",
+]

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Real NCCL layout validation; launch with torchrun on 2 or 4 CUDA ranks."""
+
+import os
+from datetime import timedelta
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers import usp
+
+
+def main():
+    rank = int(os.environ["LOCAL_RANK"])
+    torch.cuda.set_device(rank)
+    dist.init_process_group("nccl", timeout=timedelta(seconds=180))
+    try:
+        world = dist.get_world_size()
+        assert world in (2, 4)
+        group = SimpleNamespace(ulysses_group=dist.group.WORLD, ulysses_shm_handle=None)
+        ipc = "sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.distributed.device_communicators.ipc_a2a_multi.ipc_a2a_multi_ready"
+        with (
+            torch.no_grad(),
+            patch.object(usp, "get_sp_group", return_value=group),
+            patch.object(usp, "get_ulysses_parallel_world_size", return_value=world),
+            patch.object(usp, "_UNCACHED_STAGING", False),
+            patch(ipc, return_value=False),
+        ):
+            cases = 0
+            for rows in (37, 9939):
+                for dtype in (torch.bfloat16, torch.float16, torch.float32):
+                    torch.manual_seed(42 + rank)
+                    packed = torch.randn(rows, 3, 56, 128, device="cuda", dtype=dtype)
+                    qkv = tuple(packed[:, i] for i in range(3))
+                    local_heads = 56 // world
+                    expected = []
+                    for tensor in qkv:
+                        received = [torch.empty_like(tensor) for _ in range(world)]
+                        dist.all_gather(received, tensor.contiguous())
+                        expected.append(
+                            torch.cat(
+                                [
+                                    t[:, rank * local_heads : (rank + 1) * local_heads]
+                                    for t in received
+                                ]
+                            )
+                        )
+                    cached_ptr = None
+                    for plane in (False, True):
+                        with patch.object(
+                            dist, "all_to_all_single", wraps=dist.all_to_all_single
+                        ) as collective:
+                            actual = usp._usp_input_all_to_all_packed_qkv(
+                                *qkv, plane_major=plane
+                            )
+                        assert collective.call_count == 1
+                        for got, reference in zip(actual, expected):
+                            assert torch.equal(got, reference), (
+                                rank,
+                                rows,
+                                dtype,
+                                plane,
+                            )
+                            assert got.stride() == (
+                                3 * local_heads * 128,
+                                128 if plane else 3 * 128,
+                                1,
+                            )
+                        ptr = actual[0].data_ptr()
+                        if cached_ptr is not None:
+                            assert ptr == cached_ptr, (
+                                "same-size layout switch should reuse receive staging"
+                            )
+                        cached_ptr = ptr
+                        cases += 1
+            dist.barrier()
+            if rank == 0:
+                print(
+                    f"PASS: world={world}, {cases} cases/rank; real NCCL, bitwise all-gather reference, staging reuse",
+                    flush=True,
+                )
+    finally:
+        dist.destroy_process_group()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""Contract checks for the SM100 sparse Sage FP8 backend."""
+
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import Mock, patch
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.attention.backends import (

+)
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.platforms import AttentionBackendEnum

+
+class TestSubBlockSageContract(unittest.TestCase):
+    def make_impl(self, config=None):
+        with (
+            patch(
+                "sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.server_args.get_global_server_args",
+                return_value=SimpleNamespace(attention_backend_config=config or {}),
+            ),
+            patch.object(
+                fp8.SubBlockSparseAttentionFP8Impl,
+                "_build_dense_impl",
+                return_value=Mock(),
+            ),
+        ):
+            return fp8.SubBlockSparseAttentionFP8Impl(14, 128, prefix="blocks.0.attn")
+
+    def test_router_contract_independent_of_general_sage_architecture_defaults(self):
+        for config in ({}, {"compute_mode": "sage_fp8"}):
+            impl = self.make_impl(config)
+            self.assertEqual(impl.schedule.n_k, 4)
+            self.assertEqual(impl.schedule.n_q, 4)
+            self.assertEqual(impl.schedule.skip_first_steps, 10)
+            self.assertEqual(impl.schedule.skip_first_layers, 0)
+            self.assertEqual(impl.schedule.sparsity, 0.75)
+            self.assertTrue(
+                fp8.SubBlockSparseAttentionFP8Backend.supports_packed_varlen()
+            )
+            self.assertTrue(AttentionBackendEnum.SUBBLOCK_SPARSE_ATTN_FP8.is_sparse)
+            self.assertEqual(
+                str(fp8.SubBlockSparseAttentionFP8Backend.get_enum()),
+                "subblock_sparse_attn_fp8",
+            )
+
+    def test_first_ten_steps_stay_dense(self):
+        impl = self.make_impl()
+        q = torch.empty(1, 4096, 14, 128, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        with patch.object(
+            fp8, "get_forward_context", return_value=SimpleNamespace(current_timestep=9)
+        ):

+        with (
+            patch.object(
+                fp8,
+                "get_forward_context",
+                return_value=SimpleNamespace(current_timestep=10),
+            ),
+            patch.object(impl, "_sparse_attention", return_value=q) as sparse,
+        ):
+            self.assertIs(impl.forward(q, q, q), q)
+        sparse.assert_called_once()
+
+    def test_unsupported_batch_and_gqa_use_dense(self):
+        impl = self.make_impl()
+        for batch, q_heads, kv_heads in [(2, 14, 14), (1, 14, 7)]:
+            with self.subTest(batch=batch, kv_heads=kv_heads):
+                q = torch.empty(batch, 4096, q_heads, 128, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+                k = torch.empty(batch, 4096, kv_heads, 128, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+                impl.dense_impl.reset_mock()
+                with (
+                    patch.object(
+                        fp8,
+                        "get_forward_context",
+                        return_value=SimpleNamespace(current_timestep=10),
+                    ),
+                    patch.object(impl, "_sparse_attention") as sparse,
+                ):
+                    impl.forward(q, k, k)
+                impl.dense_impl.forward.assert_called_once()
+                sparse.assert_not_called()
+
+    def test_single_document_returns_attention_storage_directly(self):
+        impl = self.make_impl()
+        q = torch.empty(4097, 14, 128, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        output = torch.empty_like(q).unsqueeze(0)
+        with (
+            patch.object(impl, "_sparse_ready", return_value=True),
+            patch.object(impl, "_sparse_attention", return_value=output),
+        ):
+            result = impl.forward_varlen(
+                q,
+                q,
+                q,
+                cu_seqlens=torch.tensor([0, 4097]),
+                max_seqlen=4097,
+                cu_seqlens_host=(0, 4097),
+            )
+        self.assertEqual(result.data_ptr(), output.data_ptr())
+
+    @unittest.skipUnless(
+        torch.cuda.is_available() and torch.cuda.get_device_capability() == (10, 0),
+        "requires SM100 and FlashInfer sparse Sage FP8 dependencies",
+    )
+    def test_real_strided_quantization_and_sparse_tail(self):
+        impl = self.make_impl({"min_seq_len": 1, "skip_first_steps": 0})
+        torch.manual_seed(42)
+        packed = (
+            torch.randn(1, 652, 3, 14, 128, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16) * 0.5
+        )
+        q, k, v = (packed[:, :, i] for i in range(3))
+        quantizer = fp8.flashinfer.trtllm_sage_attention_quantize
+        with (
+            patch.object(
+                fp8,
+                "get_forward_context",
+                return_value=SimpleNamespace(current_timestep=10),
+            ),
+            patch.object(
+                fp8.flashinfer, "trtllm_sage_attention_quantize", wraps=quantizer

+        ):
+            result = impl.forward(q, k, v)
+        self.assertEqual(quantize.call_count, 1)
+        call = quantize.call_args

+        self.assertEqual(call.kwargs["q_block_size"], 1)
+        self.assertEqual(call.kwargs["k_block_size"], 16)
+        self.assertEqual(call.kwargs["qk_quant_dtype"], torch.float8_e4m3fn)

+            cum_seq_lens_q=bounds,
+            cum_seq_lens_kv=bounds,

+        plan = impl.router.route(

+        )
+        expected = fp8.load_sage_attention()(
+            q8.unsqueeze(0),
+            k8.unsqueeze(0),
+            v8.unsqueeze(0),
+            plan.index,
+            plan.topk,
+            q_scale=qs.unsqueeze(0),
+            k_scale=ks.unsqueeze(0),
+            v_scale=vs,
+            softmax_scale=impl.softmax_scale,
+            kv_splits="auto",
+        )[0]
+        self.assertEqual(result.shape, q.shape)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(result, expected, atol=0, rtol=0)
+
+    def test_short_documents_remain_dense_and_uncovered_tail_is_zero(self):
+        impl = self.make_impl()
+        q = torch.empty(4100, 14, 128, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        with (
+            patch.object(impl, "_sparse_ready", return_value=True),
+            patch.object(
+                impl,
+                "_sparse_attention",
+                side_effect=lambda q, k, v, *, out: out.fill_(1),
+            ),
+            patch.object(
+                impl,
+                "_dense_segment",
+                side_effect=lambda q, k, v: torch.full_like(q, 2),
+            ),
+        ):
+            result = impl.forward_varlen(
+                q,
+                q,
+                q,
+                cu_seqlens=torch.tensor([0, 4096, 4098]),
+                max_seqlen=4096,
+                cu_seqlens_host=(0, 4096, 4098),
+            )
+        self.assertTrue(torch.all(result[:4096] == 1))
+        self.assertTrue(torch.all(result[4096:4098] == 2))
+        self.assertTrue(torch.all(result[4098:] == 0))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
